profile.headline: Software Engineer at SLAC
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a solid understanding of hardware, and experience with hardware interfaces, distributed control, and parallel software development.

Specialties: EPICS, ada, api, assembly language, booch, c, c + +, c tools, debugging, eclipse, vme, interface design, java, laser, linux, mentoring, microprocessors,  migration, networking, object oriented design, operating systems, optimization, oscilloscope, posix, prototyping, real time, scientific, servers, soap, software architecture, solaris, system architecture, tcp/ip, unified modeling language, unix, visual studio, vxworks, writing, xml

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Control software for the LCLS x-ray laser
Implementing EPICS support for a wide range of devices including serial, USB, Modbus, Ethernet, and VME devices. Controls for analog and digital I/O, illumination, temperature control, vacuum devices, many others.
Incorporating control devices into a large distributed system, including communicating with each other on electrical, control software, and GUI levels. Collaborating with experimenters to incorporate their equipment.

positions.title: Controls Software Engineer (285)
positions.description:
Low level software for the control system of the world’s most powerful laser. Control of motors, vacuum systems, and high voltage pulsed power.
Full software lifecycle, gathering requirements, design documents and review, object and data design, API design, coding, testing, user support.
Coding in Ada, C++, and Java for embedded controllers in a large, distributed control system.
Close collaboration with users and hardware development on hardware-software interaction and features.
Developed code with tools including AccuRev, Eclipse, and Artisan Studio.
Department of Energy Q clearance

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description: JTAG chip flashing and debugging interface for multi-core systems.  Systems engineering and system level troubleshooting for development board.  C++ and assembly boot code.

positions.title: Software Enineer
positions.description: Factory automation & networked device control software.  SOAP/XML interfaces, C++ portability layer for VxWorks.

positions.title: Student Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Developed software interface to a signal processing board in a VME based test fixture as part of the ATLAS Muon detector for the CERN superconducting supercollider. Designed and implemented GUI based software for ASIC and PCB testing, debugging, data transfer and logging, test scripting, and chip configuration. Used object oriented techniques in C++ for class and interface design.  Developed software side of IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG) standard testing interface.
Collaborated on defining interface specifications between software, PCB, and ASIC designers. Used bus and logic analyzers for verification and debugging.
Laid out circuit boards in Mentor Graphics. Contracted with PCB manufacturers and BU machine shop for small production runs, ordered electronic components, assembled scientific instruments using hot air tools for small surface mount parts. Instruments included an experimental MRI device, a neural signal amplifier, and high voltage decoupling boards for the ATLAS Muon detector.
